description: Hanzhang Ge and colleagues publish railway-maintenance machinery routing benchmarks for a carbon-aware, multi-depot semi-open arc-routing problem. The June 2026 archive contains anonymised or projected network instances, solver results, heuristic comparisons and reproduction scripts. Ten small instances form an exact-validation pool; fifteen benchmark instances compare four algorithms using thirty independent runs per algorithm and instance. Calibration, convergence and statistical-test outputs are also documented. Zenodo distributes the archive free under CC BY 4.0. These materials can test routing algorithms and maintenance-logistics simulations. Gurobi verification requires a separate working installation and licence. The geographical network identity and correspondence to operational railway constraints remain unknown, and projected instances should not be treated as surveyed infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this benchmark. Files and claims of solver optimality were not independently tested.
